mispricing.note: no effect detected: rho +0.031 over 6 non-overlapping folds at 14d (+0.040 over 12 at 7d), and the market-value benchmark — a plain 'buy cheap players' rule — beat it in 5 of 6 and 9 of 12. The earlier +0.126 was measured on a board that priced IDP rows on a scale that does not exist.

sharpFlow.note: no ledger outside production; never checked against an outcome, and cannot be until the qualified cohort can be frozen as-of a date

opportunity.note: measured and rejected: adding the board-momentum axis lowered mean rho (7d -0.010 over 11 folds, 14d -0.009 over 5) and beat mispricing alone in only 3/11 and 2/5 folds. Weight is zero; the axis is displayed as evidence but does not move the score. The snapTrend axis is production-only and remains unmeasured.

_rationale: Bands are symmetric and round. They are NOT calibrated: with a
single validated component there is no basis for asserting that
+60 means anything different in kind from +55. They exist to make
the score readable, and the UI labels them experimental.
